text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I finish up training with Taiki Shuttle...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yay, all done!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I know! I'll cool down like a
champ!
choice_data_list: クールダウンはしっかりな
クールダウンはしっかりね

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hm? Who's that over there?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huff... Puff... J-just twenty more laps to... go...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Doto! You're doing great out
there!
Feelin' all right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eek! T-Taiki?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine! I'm just training by myself! So
you don't
need to... I mean...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-you don't need to worry about me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, can I ask ya something? Is it all
right if I
cool down later?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I think Doto's overworking herself again!
I know
it's nothin' new, but this time I
gotta step in...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run over as fast as I can and
give her a
big ol' hug! These arms of
mine'll get her restin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run over as fast as I can and
give her a
big ol' hug! These arms of
mine'll get her restin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes! I just knew you'd say that, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm off!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle runs off at top speed and
snatches
up Meisho Doto. It looks like
the plan to make
her take a break is
working.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suggest we ask some other trainers for
advice on
how to make Meisho Doto get
some rest.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I get it! Protecting Doto is
something we all
gotta do together—a
group mission!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You're one smart cookie, Trainer! Okay!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Let's make this mission a big success!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, with everyone's help, Meisho
Doto finally
gets some rest. Taiki Shuttle
seems very satisfied.
